extracted.name: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce
extracted.description: This quick homemade teriyaki sauce simmers soy, vinegar, and spices together until thick and glossy for chicken, veggies, or your favorite stir fry.
instruction_lines: Combine soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, water, garlic powder, onion powder, and ground ginger in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add cornstarch and mix thoroughly to dissolve. Cook until bubbles start to appear, about 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Simmer until thickened, 5 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
